description: Weak, mixed unit. Strongest when the opponent has a winning cell directly above column 2's landing cell (column 2 is poisoned, typically a diagonal threat at row 4), or a vertical three in column 0, while column 1 holds at most one stone and I have no immediate win. Moderate firing is diffuse: column 1 nearly empty, the opponent's last stone on row 3, a side must-block. Central must-blocks and column-1 stacks do not make it fire.
effect: Raises column 1: forcing it high adds about +0.2 to +0.4 probability to column 1, taken from the otherwise preferred move; zeroing it lowers column 1 by about 0.2 where column 1 was favored; no effect when a move is forced.
notes: 6 score calls; best F1 0.254 (P 0.205, R 0.334, AUROC 0.65), sim share 0.12. Must-block rule alone F1 0.21; threat-in-left-columns rules 0.14-0.18. Col 1 height<=1 is near-necessary at the top (91% band 9 vs ~38% base). Top activations share an opponent threat at (3,2) above col-2 landing; synth reaches 12.27 (> dev max 11.27). Activation is very sensitive to unrelated stones, so this may be a random or distributed direction. Col 1 is not more often the teacher's best move when it fires.
